subject: Acme procurement & security qualification - next steps (SOC 2 / DPA / PO vs card)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <j.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: procurement readiness & next steps (SOC 2 / DPA)

Thanks again for the quick chat today, Jordan — helpful to understand Acme's timeline and procurement constraints. Recap + next steps below.

Quick recap:
- You have a product team ready to pilot in Sept; procurement/finance needs paperwork in place to pay (PO preferred over corporate card).
- Security team flagged SOC 2 and DPA as gating items before final approval.
- Marketplace purchasing (AWS Marketplace) would speed PO processing for some buyers; you're checking if that helps your finance team.

Requested next steps from our side:
1) I'll share a one-page SOC 2 summary and our DPA draft for review (see attachments).
2) Aditya will follow up on commercial packaging & typical PO cadence / initial sizing for Dedicated vs Hosted.
3) Dev will provide details on data residency and audit logs if security needs specific evidence.

Could you confirm: does procurement require a DocuSign routed DPA or is a signed PDF + PO sufficient? Also, is the PO process internal only, or can a marketplace purchase (if available) shorten approvals?

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
[Attachment: redwood-dpa-draft.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]

From: Jordan Smith <j.smith@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Ramesh <priya.ramesh@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement readiness & next steps (SOC 2 / DPA)

Thanks Marissa — that recap looks right. A few notes from procurement/security side:

- Procurement prefers PO (our finance system requires a PO for subscription spend > $25k / year). Card is possible for initial pilot if under $5k but will need manual approvals.
- For legal/security: SOC 2 type II report + a standard DPA will get us through. We usually need the SOC 2 report PDF and a DPA the legal team can redline in DocuSign.
- Marketplace: yes, AWS Marketplace can be faster for PO routing in some BU cases. I'll confirm whether the central finance team accepts marketplace orders for vendor onboarding.

I'll confirm PO timing & share any procurement templates by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Smith
Senior Manager, IT Procurement — Acme Corp

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <j.smith@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 17:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Commercial path & PO sizing

Jordan — quick commercial note following Marissa's recap. For initial pilot usage we typically see a small committed monthly amount or a short-term card payment for the first 30–60 days while procurement completes a PO to cover the annual/committed contract. If PO is the path, we can provide an SOW and invoice to match your internal PO number.

Two options to consider:
A) Pilot on card (low friction) for up to $5k to accelerate kick-off; convert to PO-based contract once procurement completes onboarding.
B) If you want PO now, we can issue an invoice tied to the PO number; standard net-30 terms available.

Also noting that Marketplace (AWS) purchases are available for some of our hosted SKUs — that often speeds internal approvals because finance recognizes marketplace purchase flows. If Acme's finance will accept marketplace billing, we can share the SKU list and estimated monthly commit.

I've attached a simple commercial summary and an example invoice template.

Cheers,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-commercial-summary.pdf (PDF, 65KB)]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <j.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Security evidence & questionnaire

Jordan — following up with the items you mentioned. I've attached a copy of our standard SOC 2 summary and a bridge letter that covers controls mapping (for quick review). If your security team has a questionnaire, please send the Excel over and we’ll populate the relevant fields — we can usually return a completed questionnaire within 3 business days depending on depth.

Notes:
- Data residency: Hosted API operates in multi-region; we can support region-specific routing for EU/US. For Dedicated/Private deployments we can pin to specific VPCs.
- Audit logs: we provide token-level audit logs and retention options; we can share an example export.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, acme-security-questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Security Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acme-security-questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

From: Jordan Smith <j.smith@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Ramesh <priya.ramesh@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement readiness & next steps (SOC 2 / DPA)

Appreciate the quick turnaround, team. Procurement confirms they prefer PO for the pilot (we'll route standard PO via our ERP) — estimated completion 2–3 weeks. Legal asked for a DocuSign-ready DPA (they prefer to redline there). I'll share procurement template and our legal contact by EOD.

Marketplace: finance says AWS Marketplace would be acceptable for BU-level purchases but central vendor onboarding still needs the DPA and SOC 2 artifacts. If you can publish marketplace SKUs, please send those and we'll evaluate.

Next steps for Redwood: provide DocuSign-ready DPA, completed questionnaire (Dev mentioned ~3 business days), and SKUs for marketplace if available.

Jordan
Jordan Smith
Senior Manager, IT Procurement — Acme Corp
